name: Jesus With Us Now
overview: Scripture reveals the abiding presence of Jesus with His people, assuring believers of His constant companionship and strength. From the Old Testament promises of God's presence to Joshua and Isaiah, who encouraged courage and trust in God's sustaining power, to the New Testament affirmations where Jesus promises to be with His followers always, even to the end of the age, we see a consistent message of divine nearness. Jesus is present whenever believers gather in His name and offers eternal life through faith in Him, sustaining and nourishing His people like the bread from heaven.
